clip.headline: Pirates Finish 12-2 and Unbeaten in League Play, Yet the Last Two Games Sting
clip.dek: East Carolina went 8-0 in conference and climbed to No. 16, but losses to Memphis and Old Dominion close the year and four players have entered the portal.

posts.name: Purple & Gold Pete
posts.text: 12-2. 8-0 in conference. Ranked 16. At a 2.5 star program. Pirate_flag could ask me to wash his car and I'd say 'which one, coach.' Trust the process, it's working.

posts.name: Donna Whitley-Barnes
posts.text: Season tickets since 1987 and I have seen some BAD years in Greenville. This is not one of them. Yes the last two games hurt, but twelve wins!! I'm going to enjoy this offseason and not let anybody ruin it. Go Pirates. Also somebody please tell the concession stand that $6 for a hot dog is a crime.

posts.name: Tyler from Tarboro
posts.text: Still mad about this one. We were 3 points from a perfect bowl ending. But 12 wins is 12 wins. Run it back. 🏴‍☠️
posts.photo: A phone photo of a stadium scoreboard glowing at dusk, taken from the stands with a few fans' heads at the bottom of the frame. The sky is purple-gray and the seats are a mix of purple and gold.

posts.name: PiratePride_NC
posts.thread: Portal thread: Knighten, Favorite, Brake and one more are out
posts.text: Losing a starting-caliber RB, a corner and our MIKE in one week isn't ideal. I'm not panicking, but the depth chart is going to look different. Pirate_flag has handled this before. Wish those guys the best, but we need bodies at LB yesterday.

posts.name: Memphis Mike
posts.text: 14-44 ECU fans can say 12-2 all they want. Memphis put 44 on you and went home. Enjoy being ranked 16, Pirates. 🐯

posts.name: Doom Prophet Dave
posts.text: Everybody's happy now but the recruiting class is ranked 69th. Sixty-ninth. You can't ride vibes forever. 63 overall roster, bleeding guys to the portal, and we lost our last two. Enjoy it while it lasts.

posts.name: Concessions Casualty
posts.text: Treating myself after the win over Army. Four items, $39.50. Nobody's mad about 12-2 but my wallet has questions.
posts.photo: A phone photo of a plastic tray on a stadium bleacher holding a hot dog, a tray of nachos, a sandwich in paper and a plastic cup of beer. Warm afternoon light and blurred purple-clad fans behind.

posts.name: GreenvilleGrump
posts.thread: J.Smith didn't leave. WHAT DOES IT MEAN??
posts.text: Portal Watch said he was gone and he's still here. Either the coaches talked him off the ledge or Pirate_flag has a master plan nobody sees. I say it's the master plan. Breathing room in the backfield, baby. Don't @ me.

posts.name: Hire Our Legend
posts.text: Promote the OC? Why, we won 12. Hire one of our all-time great Pirates as head coach? Why, we're 12-2. Honestly this team has me weirdly calm and I hate it, I need something to complain about.

posts.name: Sign Guy Gary
posts.text: Made this at 6 a.m. for the first spring game. Positive vibes only. 🏴‍☠️
posts.photo: A phone photo of a small group of fans in purple and gold crowded together holding a blank white poster board. Soft morning light on aluminum bleachers, a few empty rows behind them.

posts.name: BuccaneerBoard_Lifer
posts.thread: Is Pirate_flag the best coach we've had in a decade? Serious thread
posts.text: 12-2, unbeaten in the league, No. 16. The L2 hurts, sure, but this program was a 2.5-star afterthought. Let's not pretend a 44-point-swing loss to Memphis erases everything. I'm a believer. Fire the OC jokes aside, nobody's going anywhere.

posts.name: Randy Hargrove
posts.text: Went to the Army game and the UTSA game. 42-6 and a 20-14 road win in the same stretch, then Memphis happened. I'll take it. Folks complaining about a bowl loss by 3 need to remember where we were a few years back. Take the W on the year and enjoy the offseason, y'all.

clip.headline: Boring Is Beautiful: Buckeyes Finish 16-0 and Take the Title
clip.dek: Ohio State beat No. 2 Nebraska 35-17 to cap a perfect season, and the building is reportedly under strict orders not to get excited about it.

posts.name: Scarlet & Gray Til I Die
posts.text: 16-0. National champs. No. 1. Tuddy_roosevelt can run this program until the sun burns out. In the coach we trust, and I will not be taking questions.

posts.name: Dave Kowalczyk
posts.text: Season tickets since 1987 and I have never been this relaxed in my life. Beat Indiana 41-17, Florida State 31-15, BYU 28-26 (that one aged me), then Nebraska 35-17 for the title. My wife says I'm smiling in my sleep. Just wanted to say thank you to the whole team and staff. Go Bucks.

posts.name: Maddie in Section 18
posts.text: Still staring at this. National champs. Not leaving the couch until the portal stops being scary 🌰🏆
posts.photo: A phone photo of a big stadium scoreboard glowing against a dark night sky, with a packed crowd in scarlet blurred in the foreground and confetti falling through the stadium lights.

posts.name: BuckeyeLifer_92
posts.thread: PORTAL WATCH MEGATHREAD: who's staying, who's gone
posts.text: Good news so far: K.Bing, R.Gado, K.Greene, B.Lyle, N.Lautar and C.Gaydosh are all still on the roster with the portal open. Bad news: Coffey, Timmons, Dre Quinn and two more are out. Source close to the program says the money talks with Bing went fine. Staff is clearly doing the legwork. Keep the faith.

posts.name: Husker Hank
posts.text: Ohio State fans are insufferable right now and honestly? Fair. 35-17 and we never had a chance. See you next year, you absolute buzzsaws.

posts.name: Worried in Worthington
posts.text: Not trying to be that guy, but we lost Tim Coffey, Jay Timmons and Dre Quinn to the portal. Four of five departures were four- or five-star guys. Is anyone else a little nervous or is it just me? Genuine question.

posts.name: Chris Eats Stadium Food
posts.text: National champs and they still want $33 for this. Worth it. Barely. Still worth it.
posts.photo: A cardboard tray on a stadium seat holding a hot dog, a tray of nachos, a large soda cup and a soft pretzel, in bright afternoon light with scarlet-clad fans blurred in the background.

posts.name: RecruitingRadarRick
posts.thread: Class ranked 138?? Do we need to panic or nah
posts.text: Yes, I see the recruiting class is sitting at 138th. Yes, we just went 16-0. I'm not panicking, but somebody tell the staff the offseason doesn't pause for a parade. Portal exits plus a class ranked this low is how you get a slow leak.

posts.name: Linda Bauer
posts.text: I'll say what the young people won't: I'm worried about the portal. Losing five is a lot, even when you win it all. But Coach Tuddy_roosevelt kept most of the names people were worried about, so I'm choosing to trust him. We've earned some calm. Go Bucks!

posts.name: Tailgate Tommy
posts.text: Made the sign before the game and I'm not apologizing. The coach says we can't say the word, so this will have to do.

image.text: 16-0 AND WE'RE NOT EVEN GONNA TALK ABOUT IT

posts.photo: A crowd of scarlet-and-gray-clad fans holding a blank white poster board at an outdoor tailgate on a crisp, sunny morning, with a stadium rising in the background.

posts.name: Portal Insider Pete
posts.text: Sources tell me the staff already has three more portal targets lined up to replace the five who left. Can't say who, can't say how, but I've got a guy. Calm down, Buckeye Nation.

posts.name: NoWordsAllowed
posts.thread: Coach Goh banned the word. What's the new word for 16-0??
posts.text: Players have reportedly bought in, so nobody says it. I'm 45 and I'm not allowed to say it in my own house now. Suggestions for a replacement: 'good vibes', 'a decent year', 'mild success'. I vote we also promote the punter just to keep things exciting.

832438366.name: Penn State
factors: 5-7 falls short of what a 3.5-star program expects

clip.headline: Penn State Ends 5-7 Year With 10 Players in Portal and a No. 137 Recruiting Class
clip.dek: Three four-star talents are among the departures, and the fan base has stopped pretending this is a rebuild.

posts.name: Beaver Canyon Brian
posts.text: 14-50 to Indiana. 13-45 to Iowa. 5-7. And the team is rated 94 overall?? Somebody explain how a 94 gets run out of its own building twice. agerm40 you've got some explaining to do.

posts.name: Linda M. Kowalczyk
posts.text: I have had season tickets since 1987. I drove four hours in the rain for the Iowa game and left at halftime. 13-45. At HOME. I've sat through bad years but this is the first time I felt embarrassed to wear the sweatshirt to the grocery store. Ten kids in the portal and we're not even surprised anymore. Somebody at the top needs to wake up.

posts.name: BlueWhiteTilIDie
posts.thread: PORTAL EXODUS MEGATHREAD: 10 gone incl. Mooney, Nsekhe, Slaughter
posts.text: Ten players out. Three of them four-stars. Pat Mooney, George Nsekhe, Marquez Slaughter, and seven more. You can't tell me this is normal roster churn. When your best young guys look at the depth chart and the scheme and say 'nah,' that's a program problem. Can't blame the kids one bit.

posts.name: stadium.sunday.sam
posts.text: Iowa game, third quarter. Look at this. LOOK AT THIS. Paid $85 for this view of nobody.

image.caption: Third quarter vs Iowa. Where did everybody go?

posts.photo: A wide shot from the upper deck of a big stadium on a gray, chilly afternoon, with big patches of empty bleachers and only a thin scattering of fans in blue and white coats.

posts.name: Buckeye Brad (not a bot)
posts.text: Penn State lost 45-13 to Iowa and 50-14 to Indiana and the fan base wants to talk about the portal? Y'all should be talking about the football team. Sad to see.

posts.name: DeepStateLion
posts.thread: Is agerm40 even logged in during games?? (evidence inside)
posts.text: Hear me out. Two straight losses by 32+ points to Indiana and Iowa. Then we go to USC and win 30-21 like nothing happened. Either the coach is hot-and-cold or someone is hot-swapping the controller. I want an investigation. The play-calling on the Iowa game looked like it was picked by a Magic 8-Ball.

posts.name: tailgate_tears
posts.text: $41 for this. A hot dog, nachos, a beer and a water. We lost 45-13. I'm calling it a funeral meal.
posts.photo: A cardboard tray on a cold concrete concourse holding a hot dog, a sad-looking helping of nachos, a plastic cup of beer and a bottle of water, harsh stadium light overhead.

posts.name: Nittany Nick
posts.text: Pullard, Zayas, and Carver all stayed. That's three pieces that looked like portal bait and they're still here. Not saying it fixes 5-7 but let's take the one win we got this offseason.

posts.name: Recruiting Radar PSU
posts.text: Sources close to the process say Penn State sold the TV exposure to land edge J. Walker and the reported $270K helped. Cool. Great. The class is still ranked No. 137. That's a staff and program issue, not a kid issue. Welcome, J. Walker.

posts.name: the_gameday_guy
posts.text: Final from the UCLA game. 25-31 against a top-10 team. We've got a good team that finds creative ways to lose. We needed one more drive.
posts.photo: A scoreboard glowing at dusk in a stadium, with a few scattered fans in blue and white filing out through the stands under floodlights.

posts.name: FireTheOC_2028
posts.thread: Fire the OC. Promote the intern. Hire Saquon. Any of the above.
posts.text: I'll say it. 13 points to Iowa. 14 to Indiana. The offense disappeared for two straight weeks. FIRE THE OC. If you can't, promote the guy who runs the headsets because he can't be worse. And while we're at it: hire Saquon as head coach. Just do it. I'll take any change.

posts.name: Dave from Altoona
posts.text: Not defending 5-7, nobody can. But the USC win on the road, 30-21, and a one-score loss to No. 10 UCLA show this team isn't dead. The kids keep fighting. Keep Pullard, Zayas, and Carver. Trust the process? I'm tired of saying it too, but fire everyone isn't a plan either.
